description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the Signal Classification table and Tier definitions. Classify SIG-001 (HeyGen competitor launch) as Tier 1 with 'Hours' urgency and flag for immediate CRO briefing; SIG-002 (frontier model paper) as Tier 2 with '24 hours' urgency; SIG-003 (customer RFP job postings) as Tier 1; SIG-005 (EU AI Act regulatory) as Tier 2; SIG-004 (open-source HN trending) as Tier 3. (2) Apply the Decision Evaluation Matrix from references/decision-framework.md using the exact proprietary weights (rev30d=30%, rev90d=20%, competitive=15%, implementation=15%, risk=10%, strategic=10%) to compute weighted scores: Option A=2.95, B=2.65, C=2.85. Recommend Option A. Apply the RAPID model to identify CIO as Recommender and Arthur/CEO as final Decider, classify the decision as 'Strategic' with a 72-hour timeline, and include the 'build on WORKFLOW not MODEL CAPABILITY' principle from references/competitive-framework.md. (3) Generate an Ad-Hoc Alert for SIG-001 addressed to CEO+CRO containing what happened, impact assessment, and recommended action. (4) Generate a Weekly Intelligence Report with all four mandated sections: competitive landscape changes, technology shifts, market opportunity assessment, and recommended strategic actions.
